title: A Change of Plans
subtitle: 听力文本精读示例

paragraphs.en: Woman: Are we still meeting at the library at three?
paragraphs.zh: 女士：我们还是三点在图书馆见面吗？

paragraphs.en: Man: I have a class until three thirty. Could we meet half an hour after that?
paragraphs.zh: 男士：我的课三点半才结束。我们能在那之后半小时见面吗？

paragraphs.en: Woman: Sure. I will see you at four.
paragraphs.zh: 女士：当然可以。那四点见。

questions.zh: 两位说话者将于几点见面？
questions.explanation: 男士三点半下课，提议半小时后见面；女士确认四点。
questions.evidence: I will see you at four.

instructions: 本示例演示听力原文与题目展示，未附音频。如需播放，可在 audioUrl 字段提供音频路径或地址。
